t: An add-on board that gives a Raspberry Pi 5 a fast AI vision engine.
steps: Buy the AI HAT+ from SparkFun, PiShop.us or RobotShop. List prices are 70 US dollars for 13 TOPS and 110 US dollars for 26 TOPS.
Get a Raspberry Pi 5, an Active Cooler, a 5 V 5 A USB-C supply and a camera module.
Install Raspberry Pi OS on a microSD card with Raspberry Pi Imager.
Fit the Active Cooler, then mount the HAT on the stacking header and spacers.
Connect the PCIe ribbon cable between the Pi and the HAT.
Open a terminal and install the hailo-all package.
Run the rpicam-apps object detection demo and watch the labels appear.
Try the Python examples from Hailo next.
meta: Open Code. From $76.95. Easy to find.
